historical_milestones.notes: WMMA prefill rel-attn, IQ3_XXS/IQ4_NL MoE, adaptive 128x64/32 prefill (4.08x prefill), 100% exact SHA.

historical_milestones.label: Round 4 + Native DSpark Q4_K (0xfc0369c3ffff)

historical_milestones.label: Phase 5 (Q4_K output.weight + Disk Cache + kv_grow)

historical_milestones.notes: Mask 0x67dfc0369c3ffff (-648 launches) + DCACHE_VERSION 3 (-49.3% ckpt, -45.4% warm load). Live R00 measured fresh in campaign below.

rounds.name: Overlapped Async Pinned Disk-Cache Streaming Restore

source.title: LMCache / Mooncake Async Pinned Disk-Cache Pipeline (arXiv:2510.09665, arXiv:2407.00079)

rounds.hypothesis: Pre-warm 4 pooled pinned k-block buffers in gen_disk_open(), read e checkpoint into plain 4K-aligned host RAM (skipping cold 215 MB hipHostMalloc GART pinning), overlap k-block NVMe reads + H2D DMA ahead of e wait, and raise SNAP_PIN_CH 4->16 MiB pre-allocated at gpu_open().
rounds.notes: Reverted to opt-in (IE_DISK_STREAM=1) & restored SNAP_PIN_CH=4 MiB: 516 MB / 153 ms = 3.37 GB/s already saturates NVMe ceiling in R01; plain _aligned_malloc page-faults + 16 MiB chunk reduced overlap (warm TTFT 207->226 ms, disk 153->173 ms, -13 MB VRAM free). Parity EXACT under --poison-cache.
